title: Instakill (Library of Ruina)
description: Every librarian (Player faction) die rolls 999 and its damage fields are set to 999, as host callbacks on observation gates. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Instakill
launcher.note: All librarians have their dice roll and damage values set to 999

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file); words read from that file.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleDiceBehavior.UpdateDiceFinalValue epilogue (every path that stores _diceFinalResultValue at 0x244e980 reaches it, and so do the early exits): x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior
BattleDiceBehavior.GiveDamage, right after stp w25,w8,[x19,#84] stores _diceResultDamage / _diceDamageAll: x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior
